scope: Fourteen overlapping research entries, not fourteen proven errors, crimes or independent incidents. Each is a document observation with separate inference and disconfirming target.

entries.title: Drafting-role conflict
entries.evidence_type: Observation of released records / attributed retrospective statement
entries.observation: Osmus names Brown as typist and Schuessler as the source of the liaison conversation; Schuessler names Miller and Osmus as compilers; Miller denies preparing the answer; Brown describes handing it to Garvey.
entries.inference: Specific authoring/custodian/transmission targets can be pursued.
entries.strongest_alternative_or_objection: Roles such as typing, supplying information, compiling and forwarding differ; later memory may be inaccurate. These possibilities do not remove the recorded attribution conflict.
entries.what_would_change_assessment: Native drafts, revision history, approvals, Brown-to-Garvey handoff and Garvey-to-Commission transport/receipt records.
entries.record_support_grade: A: directly checked wording or fields in identified released copies; not an A-grade finding that every historical assertion is true
entries.conspiracy_inference_grade: D: underdetermined from these records alone
entries.originals_status: Raw source versions retained unchanged; native audio/email/attachment authentication remains separate

entries.title: Awareness-date conflict
entries.evidence_type: Observation of released records / attributed retrospective statement
entries.observation: Records describe possibly the same/next day, perhaps a couple of weeks later, weeks later, or a summer discussion; liaison interviewee cannot date the clarification.
entries.inference: The date and recipients of actual knowledge remain material unresolved facts.
entries.strongest_alternative_or_objection: Uncertain memory and different conversations could produce these accounts; source wording does not identify a single date.
entries.what_would_change_assessment: Contemporaneous calendar, messages, notes, calls and recipient acknowledgment.

entries.title: Expected correction versus no instruction
entries.evidence_type: Observation of released records / attributed retrospective statement
entries.observation: Osmus says the answer was inaccurate as presented and expected the liaison interview to clarify it; liaison interviewee says nobody asked for that clarification; Miller did not recall transmitting it.
entries.inference: A follow-through and accountability gap is specifically supported as a record question.
entries.strongest_alternative_or_objection: Expecting an interview to communicate a fact is not the same as issuing an instruction; confusion or poor process remains possible.
entries.what_would_change_assessment: Actual liaison Commission interview/audio, written clarification request, staff receipt and amended answer.
entries.record_support_grade: A: directly checked wording or fields in identified released copies; not an A-grade finding that every historical assertion is true
entries.conspiracy_inference_grade: D: underdetermined from these records alone
entries.relative_weight: strongest direct knowledge-and-follow-through lead in this review
entries.originals_status: Raw source versions retained unchanged; native audio/email/attachment authentication remains separate

entries.title: Building, upstairs, bridge and NORAD-contact events
entries.evidence_type: Observation of released records / attributed retrospective statement
entries.observation: Liaison interview describes building arrival before second impact, upstairs arrival after Pentagon impact and uncertain clock times; Miller recalls a later building arrival. Liaison interviewee also disputes immediate NORAD contact and hotline implication.
entries.inference: Separate event fields are necessary; contradictory building-arrival accounts remain open.
entries.strongest_alternative_or_objection: Later descriptions may refer to different locations or phases, but that has not been established as the cause of the conflicting building-arrival statements.
entries.what_would_change_assessment: Access logs, contemporaneous notes, phone records, actual room/bridge logs and original audio.
entries.record_support_grade: A: directly checked wording or fields in identified released copies; not an A-grade finding that every historical assertion is true
entries.conspiracy_inference_grade: D: underdetermined from these records alone

entries.observation: OIG did not find sufficient intentional-falsity/purposeful-omission evidence for notification claims; report attributes AA77 error to inaccurate chronologies, notes workload; Schuessler denies intentional misleading; liaison disclaims clock confidence.
